# Renan Catan — public professional profile

> Renan Catan is a Brazil-based Data Engineer working remotely with US and distributed teams. He builds data platforms, warehouse and lakehouse layers, product-data integrations, and practical AI workflows with Python and SQL at the core.

## Capability priority

1. Applied AI and LLM workflows: LLMs, agent workflows, embedding models, vector databases, RAG, natural-language-to-SQL.
2. Data architecture and warehouses: data warehouses, medallion architecture, Delta Lake, dimensional modeling, batch and streaming.
3. Core data engineering: Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, ETL/ELT, APIs, data quality, testing, and monitoring.
4. Distributed data and cloud platforms: Spark, PySpark, Databricks, Google BigQuery, AWS, and Azure.
5. Product and customer data: RudderStack, Mixpanel, CleverTap, Braze, event schemas, identity, analytics, and activation.
6. Delivery, software, and analytics: Docker, Git, Terraform, Kubernetes, JavaScript/TypeScript, and BI.
